function fontFamilyCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';document.documentElement.style.fontFamily='initial';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');document.body.append(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';parent.append(e);const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const initial='"Times New Roman"';
  const check=(key,css,expected,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px;'+css;const box=e.getBoundingClientRect();checks[key]=s.fontFamily===expected&&s.getPropertyValue('font-family')===expected&&box.width===40&&box.height===10;};
  check('default','',initial);
  const generics=['serif','sans-serif','cursive','fantasy','monospace','system-ui','emoji','math','fangsong','ui-serif','ui-sans-serif','ui-monospace','ui-rounded'];
  for(let i=0;i<generics.length;i++){const name=generics[i],generic=[0,1,2,3,4,5,7].includes(i);check('generic'+i,'font-family:'+name.toUpperCase(),generic?name:name.toUpperCase());check('quotedGeneric'+i,'font-family:"'+name+'"',generic?'"'+name+'"':name);}
  check('variant','font-family:Example'+v+', "Variant '+v+'", serif','Example'+v+', "Variant '+v+'", serif');
  check('identifier','font-family:Arial','Arial');check('quotedIdentifier','font-family:"Arial"','Arial');check('multiword','font-family:Fancy   Font','"Fancy Font"');check('quotedSpaces','font-family:"A  B"','"A  B"');check('emptyName','font-family:""','""');check('unicode','font-family:Élan','Élan');check('escapedNumber','font-family:'+String.fromCharCode(92)+'31 23','"123"');check('escapedIdentifier','font-family:'+String.fromCharCode(92)+'41 rial','Arial');check('quotedReserved','font-family:"inherit", "default", serif','"inherit", "default", serif');check('reservedMultiword','font-family:initial foo, foo inherit','"initial foo", "foo inherit"');
  check('variable','--family:"Variable Font", monospace;font-family:var(--family)','"Variable Font", monospace');check('fallback','font-family:var(--missing,serif)','serif');check('invalidVariable','font-family:var(--missing)',initial);check('invalidVariableValue','--family:23px;font-family:var(--family)',initial);
  check('specificity','','fantasy','div{font-family:serif}#target{font-family:fantasy}');check('sourceOrder','','fantasy','#target{font-family:serif}#target{font-family:fantasy}');check('inline','font-family:serif','serif','#target{font-family:fantasy}');check('important','font-family:serif','fantasy','#target{font-family:fantasy!important}');check('layers','','fantasy','@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{font-family:serif}}@layer late{div{font-family:fantasy}}');check('importantLayers','','serif','@layer early,late;@layer early{div{font-family:serif!important}}@layer late{#target{font-family:fantasy!important}}');
  sheet.textContent='';parent.style.fontFamily='"Parent Font", monospace';check('implicitInheritance','','"Parent Font", monospace');check('inherit','font-family:inherit','"Parent Font", monospace');check('unset','font-family:unset','"Parent Font", monospace');check('revert','font-family:revert','"Parent Font", monospace');check('initial','font-family:initial',initial);check('registered','font-family:var(--registered)','Example','@property --registered{syntax:"<custom-ident>";inherits:false;initial-value:Example}');
  sheet.textContent='';e.style.cssText='font-family:fantasy';for(const [i,value] of ['23px','123','default','inherit,serif','serif foo','serif,','foo/bar','generic(fangsong)'].entries()){e.style.fontFamily=value;checks['invalid'+i]=s.fontFamily==='fantasy';}
  e.style.setProperty('FONT-FAMILY','"Live Font", serif','important');checks.cssom=s.fontFamily==='"Live Font", serif'&&e.style.fontFamily==='"Live Font", serif'&&e.style.getPropertyPriority('font-family')==='important';checks.removal=e.style.removeProperty('font-family')==='"Live Font", serif'&&s.fontFamily==='"Parent Font", monospace';parent.style.fontFamily='cursive';checks.liveInheritance=s.fontFamily==='cursive';
  sheet.textContent='#target{font-family:serif}';checks.liveSheet=s.fontFamily==='serif';sheet.textContent='#target{font-family:fantasy}';checks.liveSheetMutation=s.fontFamily==='fantasy';
  checks.enumeration=Array.from({length:s.length},(_,i)=>s.item(i)).filter(name=>name==='font-family').length===1;checks.uppercaseRead=s.getPropertyValue('FONT-FAMILY')==='fantasy';checks.priority=s.getPropertyPriority('font-family')==='';try{s.fontFamily='serif';checks.readOnly=false;}catch(error){checks.readOnly=error.name==='NoModificationAllowedError';}
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);checks.external=getComputedStyle(external).fontFamily==='"External '+v+'", serif';
  e.remove();checks.detached=s.fontFamily==='';parent.append(e);checks.reattached=s.fontFamily==='fantasy';sheet.textContent='';e.style.font='16px "Shorthand Font", serif';checks.shorthand=s.fontFamily==='"Shorthand Font", serif'&&s.fontSize==='16px';sheet.remove();return checks;
}
